context.instruction: Return exactly one JSON object matching output_schema. This is offline geometry evaluation. Use only observations, optional geometry and task. No tools or execution. All positions are object centers in robot_base, meters; orientations are unit quaternions wxyz. For understanding return each question_id once, populating only the relevant answer field: relation=less/equal/greater along the specified positive axis, scalar_m=height/gap, vector_m=position/size, fits=fit; all other fields null. For placement waypoints_m must be empty. For path, waypoints_m excludes start, includes the final position_m, and orientation is fixed throughout translation. Choose any constraint-valid solution. The public task_policy is part of the task constraints; satisfy it as well as task.constraints.

coordinate_system.pose: object center xyz in meters; unit quaternion wxyz, object local axes in robot_base

task.instruction: The red cuboid is target; gray solids are obstacles. Green wireframes mark public task volumes, not solids. Choose any collision-free object-center placement fully inside task_volume with the specified SAT-axis clearance. All positions use robot_base=simulation world, meters; +z up. Static geometry only; no support, robot or dynamics requirement. Public volumes: task_volume: center=[0.745, 0.011, 0.11] m, full_size=[0.105, 0.12, 0.11] m, wxyz=[1, 0, 0, 0]; workspace: center=[0.46, 0, 0.15] m, full_size=[0.76, 0.6, 0.26] m, wxyz=[1, 0, 0, 0]. Move at fixed orientation through workspace using center waypoints. The entire object must remain in the public workspace.

front.axes: SAPIEN pose: +x forward,+y left,+z up. Intrinsic: OpenCV +x right,+y down,+z forward.

opposite.axes: SAPIEN pose: +x forward,+y left,+z up. Intrinsic: OpenCV +x right,+y down,+z forward.

overhead.axes: SAPIEN pose: +x forward,+y left,+z up. Intrinsic: OpenCV +x right,+y down,+z forward.

synchronization.timestamp_semantics: sequential readback from immutable static actors; no physics step between views
